subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: After the inefficient-regex blocker is fixed and exact-head checks are green, should the authorization, proof lifecycle, durable routing, validation isolation, and bounded-requeue changes land together in this PR?
rationale: The implementation is extensively tested, but only the repair owner can accept the combined privileged automation blast radius and the terminal behavior after bounded requeue recovery is exhausted.

options.title: Fix and land together
options.body: Repair the regex, add adversarial coverage, confirm the exact privileged invariants and bounded-requeue policy, then merge the combined fail-closed rollout.

options.title: Split recovery policy
options.body: Land the proof, routing, and mutation hardening separately while moving bounded-requeue terminal behavior to a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Keep draft paused
options.body: Leave the PR open as a draft until the production contract can be reviewed with a smaller risk surface.

recommendation.title: Fix and land together
recommendation.body: Repair the regex, add adversarial coverage, confirm the exact privileged invariants and bounded-requeue policy, then merge the combined fail-closed rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy makes Peter the clearest available owner for decisions affecting live ClawSweeper workflow behavior.
